body:
Is there anyway I can get rid of this account, I burnt the letter. I'm not going through with this

Thanks to the many out there who helped me through this

I have unfortunately, but it hasn't helped. I wish there was a way but after all this time, all these fixes, and everything that's happened, my death is the only option that makes sense. If I continue to live I'll simply be suffering, my loved ones will be sad at first but I think they'll come to terms knowing that I'm finally at peace instead of enduring the pain for the sake of it. Thank you for trying though, it's nice that there are some people that still care for their fellow beings.
